#!/usr/bin/env python3
"""
Register feature table 'transactionsef8bac' v1 from the two export CSV files.
Deduplicates by row_id (exports overlap), uses row_id as record key and event_time as event-time column.
Enables online/real-time access.
"""
import os
import pandas as pd
import hopsworks

# Login to Hopsworks
hopsworks.login()
fs = hopsworks.feature_store()

# Read both CSV files
df1 = pd.read_csv("data/transactions_export_1.csv")
df2 = pd.read_csv("data/transactions_export_2.csv")

# Concatenate and deduplicate by row_id (keep first occurrence)
df = pd.concat([df1, df2], ignore_index=True)
df = df.drop_duplicates(subset=["row_id"], keep="first")

print(f"Total rows after deduplication: {len(df)}")
print(f"Unique row_ids: {df['row_id'].nunique()}")

# Define schema for the feature table
# event_time is epoch milliseconds (bigint)
schema = {
    "row_id": "String",
    "account_id": "String",
    "event_time": "Long",
    "amount": "Double",
    "category": "String",
}

# Create or get the feature group
fg_name = "transactionsef8bac"
version = 1

# Check if feature group already exists
try:
    fg = fs.get_feature_group(name=fg_name, version=version)
    print(f"Feature group {fg_name} v{version} already exists")
except Exception:
    # Create new feature group
    fg = fs.create_feature_group(
        name=fg_name,
        version=version,
        description="Transactions feature table from export files",
        online_enabled=True,  # Enable online/real-time access
        time_travel_format="HOPSFS",
    )
    print(f"Created feature group {fg_name} v{version}")

# Get or create the feature group for writing
fg = fs.get_or_create_feature_group(
    name=fg_name,
    version=version,
    primary_key=["row_id"],
    event_time_column="event_time",
    description="Transactions feature table from export files",
    online_enabled=True,
    time_travel_format="HOPSFS",
)

print(f"Feature group: {fg.name} v{fg.version}")
print(f"Primary key: {fg.primary_key}")
print(f"Event time column: {fg.event_time_column}")

# Insert the data
fg.insert(df, write_options={"wait_for_job": True})

print("Data inserted successfully")

# Verify the data is there
feature_view = fs.get_or_create_feature_view(
    name=fg_name,
    version=1,
    query=fg.select_all(),
)

print(f"Feature view created: {feature_view.name} v{feature_view.version}")

# Check online enabled
print(f"Online enabled: {fg.online_enabled}")

print("Done!")
